Variants.Content: Entry The Fist of the First People is a high hill in the Ghost Forest outside the Great Wall. It is shaped like a giant's fist, hence its name. It is not a town, but it is a rare highland in the northern wilderness: standing on the peak can look across the sea of ​​trees into the distance, and the slope at the foot of the peak can also form a temporary camp The name of the First Men indicates that this is considered part of a very ancient land, and the surrounding forests, snow, beasts and silence are more real than any map boundary. Both Night's Watch and the free folk may use it as a waypoint, a rallying point, or a shelter, but its value comes from the terrain itself, not a single variable action. Fist Peak has always been just a stone in the wilderness that allows people to see farther and be seen more easily.
